faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About AI Action Figure
faq.description: Have another question? Contact us by email.

items.title: What is AI Action Figure web tool?
items.description: AI Action Figure is a web-based tool that uses advanced AI technology to transform your photos into personalized action figures. Simply upload your photo through our website, and our AI will create a detailed 3D model of you as an action figure.

items.title: How do I use the AI Action Figure web tool?
items.description: Using our web tool is simple: 1) Visit our website, 2) Upload a clear photo of yourself, 3) Choose your preferred style and pose, 4) Let our AI generate your action figure, 5) Download or share your result. No software installation required - everything happens in your web browser.

items.title: What types of photos work best with the AI tool?
items.description: For best results, use clear, well-lit photos with your face clearly visible. Full-body photos work best for full action figures, while headshots are perfect for bust-style figures. Avoid blurry or dark photos for optimal results.

items.title: What styles and customization options are available?
items.description: Our web tool offers various styles including superhero, fantasy, sci-fi, and casual. You can customize poses, expressions, costumes, and accessories. We regularly add new styles and options to keep the experience fresh and exciting.

items.title: How long does it take to generate my action figure?
items.description: Most action figures are generated within 1-2 minutes. The exact time may vary depending on the complexity of your request and current server load. You'll see a progress indicator while your figure is being generated.

items.title: What can I do with my generated action figure?
items.description: Once generated, you can download your action figure in various formats (PNG, JPG), share it directly to social media, or save it for personal use. Premium users can also access additional formats and higher resolution options.

items.title: Is there a limit to how many action figures I can create?
items.description: The number of action figures you can create depends on your subscription plan. Free users get a limited number of generations per month, while premium users enjoy unlimited generations and access to exclusive styles and features.

items.title: How do I get the best quality results?
items.description: For optimal results: use high-quality, well-lit photos, choose poses that match your desired style, and take advantage of our style presets. Our AI works best with clear, front-facing photos in good lighting conditions.
